name: Recurring Dates Field Search API
description: Provides Search API support for recurring date (date_recur) fields.

suggests.search_api_common_field: Search API Common Fields lets you index common fields shared between the Content datasources and the Date Occurrence datasources.

project_description: This module provides Search API support for fields created with the Recurring Dates Field (date_recur) module. It defines an additional content-entity datasource for each recurring-date field. This datasource should be used instead of the Content datasource that ships with Search API. The recurring-date datasource generates multiple items for each occurrence of a recurring-date field, up to a configurable point in the future (a PHP DateInterval pre-create period, default P2Y). Each occurrence appears as a separate search result, further multiplied by each translation. When search items are loaded, the occurrence date is set on a computed date-range field on the entity; that computed field should be used for filtering, sorting, and displaying results instead of the recurring-date field. It is fine to mix these datasources with Search API's own Content datasources for bundles that do not have a recurring-date field. Requires Recurring Dates Field (date_recur), Search API, and Computed Field (>=4.0.0); the Search API Common Fields module is recommended so common fields can be shared across datasources.
